natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports shortening onboarding plus reducing signup friction. This directly addresses the current funnel problem without sacrificing durable revenue through broad discounting. A small guarded test should measure activation, time-to-value, qualified conversion, and downstream retention or revenue to detect any quality tradeoff.
